entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Sarah. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return this helmet I just bought. It's completely wrong and I want my money back immediately.
I can certainly look into that return for you. To make sure I understand correctly, could you tell me what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or a preference?
Are you serious? It's the wrong color! It looks nothing like the picture online. I'm not wearing this ugly thing. The box is still unopened, I haven't even touched it. This is ridiculous!
Okay, I understand. So the issue is the color of the helmet. Thank you for clarifying that. I just need to pull up your order details. Can I get your name and order number, please?

The name is Mike Peterson, and I don't have the order number handy! You should be able to find it. This is taking forever. If you can't do a simple return, get me your manager right now. I'm about to post a review about this terrible service.

I understand your frustration, Mike, and I am confident I can resolve this for you without needing a manager. One moment while I find your order with your name... Okay, I see it. The Trail Helmet in Forest Green, delivered on January 3rd. Is that correct?
Yeah, whatever. 'Forest Green.' It looks like swamp sludge. Are you going to give me my money back or not?

Yes, absolutely. I can see you received the item just four days ago. Our standard return policy for gear like a helmet is 90 days. Since you're well within that window, I can process a full refund for you right away. We want to make sure you're completely satisfied, especially with equipment that relates to your safety.
Oh. Well... okay. So you're just going to approve it then?

That's correct. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. All you need to do is print it, attach it to the original packaging since the box is unopened, and drop it at a post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be processed back to your original payment method.
Okay. Fine. I see the email. Thank you.
You're very welcome, Mike. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
